title: Gulliver's Travels

card.teaser: A full paperback wrap: a rooster crushing eggs, for a war over which end to crack.

summary: A full paperback wrap for Jonathan Swift's satire: a rooster crushing eggs, for a war over which end to crack.
meta: Front cover, spine, back cover, illustration

hero.alt: A Gulliver's Travels paperback with a rooster and eggs on the cover.

overview.challenge: Turn Swift's absurd war between the Big-Endians and Little-Endians into a single cover image.
overview.solution: A rooster crushing eggs: a silly argument blown up into real destruction, which is the whole point of the satire.
overview.outcome: Front, spine and back designed as one continuous wrap, with the illustration holding it together.
